# #17 Collapsible sections — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS.** No blocker or major defects. Two minor and one cosmetic finding.

Method: I did not read the src/ code or the diff. Playwright drivers are in `.verify/qa/17/qa{,2,3,4}.mjs`. Each run went through
`scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node .verify/qa/17/<x>.mjs` against a throwaway prod stack.
Logs are `.verify/qa/17/run1.log` and `run2.log`, and the screenshots are `.verify/qa/17/*.png`. Docs were created through the API (`createDoc`, mode publish) and through the `?filePath=` loader.
Viewports were 1400×900, 820×1180 and 390×844 (touch, hover:none). I checked all 6 themes.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-17.1 PASS: toggles appear on t,a,a1,b (and c,d). There are 0 in the blockquote, list and `<details>`. The toggle is a `<button>` labelled "Fold section A", aria-expanded=true.
- AC-17.2 PASS: the 4 blocks are `hidden="until-found"`, A1 is not visible, B is visible, aria-expanded=false, the label reads "Unfold section A" and the ellipsis "⋯" shows. Clicking the ellipsis unfolds.
- AC-17.3 PASS: the gap to B is 30px.
- AC-17.4 PASS: A1 stays folded (store `["a1"]`) after A is folded and unfolded.
- AC-17.5 PASS: collapse-all leaves T, intro, A[F], B[F], C[F] and D[F] visible, and A1 is hidden. Expand-all leaves 0 hidden, the store holds `[]` and `<details>` is untouched.
- AC-17.6 PASS: the fold survives a reload. A fresh context shows it unfolded. The key is `md-review-fold:<backend id>`, and a local doc uses `md-review-fold:local:local.md`.
- AC-17.7 PASS: A stays folded after a PUT /markdown live sync. This also holds while the URL has a `#a1` fragment. Split view (#7) is not in this lane, so it was not tested.
- AC-17.8 PASS: these all unfold A, scroll A1 into view and drop `a` from the store: deep link `/d/<slug>#a1`, a TOC link click, an in-doc `[x](#a1)` link, a manual `location.hash` edit, and Back to `#a1`. Forward also works.
- AC-17.9 PASS: `#hidden-h` opens the closed `<details>` and the heading is in view.
- AC-17.10 PASS: Tab order hits t,a,a1,b. Enter folds and Space unfolds. The focus ring is a 2px solid outline with `:focus-visible` (`kbd-focus-ring.png`). At 390×844 the toggles show at opacity 0.6 with a 44×44 hit area, and there is no horizontal overflow.
- AC-17.11 PASS: under print media A1 is 27px tall, the details body is 25px tall, and 0 toggles or ellipses are displayed. Back on screen A is still folded.
- AC-17.12 PASS: 1px solid border, radius 6px (8px in Locus), summary weight 600, pointer cursor, chevron (`details-closed.png` / `details-open.png`). Enter on the summary toggles it. Nested details are indented.
- AC-17.13 PASS: with localStorage throwing, folding still works, with 0 page errors and no toast. The only `[role=alert]` is the empty live region that was already there before the fold.
- AC-17.14 PASS: an HTML doc in an iframe shows 0 fold controls in the parent and in the frame.

## Other rules and edge cases (all PASS unless noted)
- Rule 6: the heading text x position stays at 445px whether idle, hovered or folded. Opacity is 0 idle and 1 on hover, and a folded toggle stays visible. Desktop hit area is 24×24.
- Rule 7: clicking the heading text does not fold.
- Rule 14: dispatching `beforematch` unfolds the section. The sidebar scroll-to-comment flow (`scrollToLine`) was **BLOCKED** because I did not have time to set up a review-mode comment fixture.
- Duplicate headings: folding `notes-1` leaves `notes` open. After the first `Notes` is removed, the stored `notes-1` folds nothing.
- An H4 followed directly by an H2 gets no toggle, and neither does a last heading with no body. A doc with no headings shows no controls, and neither does a doc with only H5s.
- 500 headings: collapse-all takes 113ms wall time including Playwright overhead. Expand-all runs synchronously in 4ms.
- Mermaid diagram inside a fold: after unfolding it renders correctly (`mermaid-unfold.png`).
- 9 rapid toggle clicks leave a consistent DOM and store. Six rapid collapse/expand pairs leave everything visible.
- Phone and tablet: collapse-all and expand-all sit in the TOC drawer header and work (`phone-drawer.png`).
- Edit view shows no fold UI. Going back to Read re-applies the stored folds.
- Themes: light, dark, github-light, github-dark, locus-light and locus-dark all get a styled details box with a theme border colour. Toggles and ellipses read correctly in all of them (`theme-*-top.png`, `theme-*-details.png`).

## Defects
1. **minor**: switching Edit→Read while the URL still has a fragment (e.g. `#a1`) unfolds the section the reader folded afterwards, and writes `[]` to the store. Repro: open `/d/<slug>#a1`, fold A, click Edit, click Read. The store goes from `["a"]` to `[]` (`qa4.mjs`). A live sync with the same lingering fragment correctly keeps A folded. Rule 13 lists navigation events only, and a view toggle is not one of them.
2. **minor**: phone and tablet heading text is indented about 34px relative to body paragraphs, because the reserved toggle gutter sits inside the content column. Headings inside blockquotes and lists are not indented, so heading alignment is inconsistent (`phone-folded.png`). The spec only requires the gutter on desktop.
3. **cosmetic**: on touch, tapping a toggle flashes the default blue `-webkit-tap-highlight-color` rectangle over it (`phone-folded.png`).
